837:t_1:5.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「This is our world's $$枢密参謀院$$.」

837:t_1:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「The $$地球帝国$$'s highest authority... So this was transported here, too...」

837:t_1:7.en:
$$長老$$
「Though in this world, we are merely spectators with no power.」

837:t_1:8.en:
$$長老$$
「Still, there is something to be said for living a long life. I may see humanity's rite of passage into true adulthood with my own eyes.」

837:t_1:9.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「As ordered, I have brought $$ラルク・メルク・マール$$.」

837:t_1:10.en:
$$長老$$
「Thank you, Colonel $$ハトリ$$. I appreciate your declining evacuation to $$蒼の地球$$ to lend us your strength.」

837:t_1:11.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「Not at all... As a member of the Space Force, I had already decided to support the Galactic Raid Fleet.」

837:t_1:12.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So why did you bring me here? I went separately from $c because I heard you had the key to saving humanity...」

837:t_1:14.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What are you trying to say?」

837:t_1:15.en:
$$長老$$
「We have investigated both you and that $$バスターマシン７号$$... the android called $$ノノ$$.」

837:t_1:16.en:
$$長老$$
「You feel a distance between yourself and that android. It comes from her transcendent power...」

837:t_1:17.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Who cares about 'No. 7'? She's just herself.」

837:t_1:18.en:
$$長老$$
「Heh... It seems I have been rude.」

837:t_1:19.en:
$$長老$$
「You have acquired power. Enough power to move a planet.」

837:t_1:20.en:
$$長老$$
「You who move planets... I would like you to save humanity with that power.」

837:t_1:21.en:
$$長老$$
「Even if it means sacrificing Earth.」

837:t_1:23.en:
$$長老$$
「Humanity is about to move beyond the age of fire... the power of 'guns,' and enter a new era.」

837:t_1:24.en:
$$長老$$
「Perhaps what awaits us there is power beyond that of the $$トップレス$$...」

837:t_1:25.en:
$$長老$$
「Yes... the power of the $$宇宙怪獣$$, for example...」

837:t_1:26.en:
$$長老$$
「$$バアル$$ exists through a concept opposed to the power of life... in other words, the $$宇宙怪獣$$...」

837:t_1:27.en:
$$長老$$
「Perhaps that is where humanity is headed.」

837:t_1:28.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...Whoever survives can decide what comes after this.」

837:t_1:29.en:
$$長老$$
「That may be all those who are not gods can do.」

837:t_1:30.en:
$$長老$$
「Thank you, mover of planets. I wanted to meet you and see for myself.」

837:t_1:31.en:
$$長老$$
「I will give you the key.」

837:t_1:32.en:
$$ラルク$$
「The key... the power to save humanity...」

837:t_1:33.en:
$$長老$$
「Yes. I will entrust it to you.」

837:t_1:34.en:
$$ラルク$$
(Wait for me, $$ノノ$$... I'm... coming to save you...)

837:t_1:35.en:
$$ラルク$$
(But not because I'm your Big Sis. I'm your...)

837:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The final battle at the galactic center...」

837:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We're facing trouble right from the first step...」

837:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But we've come this far, and there's no turning back! All that's left is to fight with no thought for ourselves!」

837:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So we'll do what we always do! Let's get down to... business, business!」

838:t_000:0.en:
$$リーロン$$
「Everything's going smoothly. The fields surrounding each ship are stable, too.」

838:t_000:1.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「I never imagined we would manage to fight alongside that writhing metal.」

838:t_000:2.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「You knew about the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, $$ロージェノム$$?」

838:t_000:3.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「They existed in a different world from ours, but I had heard of them.」

838:t_000:4.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Apparently, their nature differed so greatly from organic life that both sides largely refrained from interfering with each other.」

838:t_000:5.en:
$$ニア$$
「Did the $$螺旋族$$ travel between parallel worlds, too?」

838:t_000:6.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Only to a limited extent.」

838:t_000:7.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「And apparently our ancestors once fought those beings called $$御使い$$s alongside the $$プロトカルチャー$$.」

838:t_000:8.en:
$$リーロン$$
「Maybe the $$ゼントラーディ$$ feel nostalgic about $$螺旋族$$ technology because memories of that time are engraved in their genes.」

838:t_000:9.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「But we must not forget...」

838:t_000:10.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「That even an alliance of prehistoric civilizations, said to be more advanced than we are today, could not defeat those $$御使い$$s.」

838:t_000:11.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「So we're challenging enemies that powerful...」

838:t_000:12.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「If we give in to despair, defeat is certain... But clinging to groundless hope gives us no chance of victory, either.」

838:t_000:13.en:
$$ニア$$
「$c has the key to breaking through that.」

838:t_000:14.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「What is that key?」

838:t_000:15.en:
$$ニア$$
「It's something we've built through all our battles up to now.」

838:t_000:16.en:
$$ニア$$
「Through it, the $$暗黒大陸$$ became the $$新世界大陸$$, and $$シモン$$ and I were brought together.」

838:t_000:18.en:
$$ニア$$
「We believe in our friends and ourselves, and unite our hearts and our strength... That's all there is to it.」

838:t_000:19.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Hmm... Indeed, perhaps that is the truth...」

838:t_000:20.en:
$$シベラ$$
「Dimensional boundary distortion confirmed! Something is teleporting into this dimension!」

838:t_001:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「I never imagined they'd attack us in this space...!」

838:t_001:2.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「They mean to stop us from advancing!」

838:t_002:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Their attacks are concentrated on the two ships at our left and right wings!」

838:t_002:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「This is bad! We'll head to support them immediately!」

838:t_002:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But if we break formation here, we'll split our forces in two! That's probably what the enemy wants!」

838:t_002:3.en:
$$號$$
「We'll handle things here on our own! The main force should support the $$マクロス・クォーター$$!」

838:t_002:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We have the $$フロンティア船団$$ with us! We can manage to hold out on our own!」

838:t_002:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Check the forces stationed on the $$真ドラゴン$$ and the $$クォーター$$!」

838:t_002:6.en:
$$フェルト$$
「On the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ are $$マジンガーＺ$$, $$ビューナスＡ$$, $$ボスボロット$$, the Getter Team, $$ダイターン３$$, $$ザンボット３$$...」

838:t_002:7.en:
$$フェルト$$
「And $$トライダーＧ７$$ and the $$シャトル$$!」

838:t_002:8.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「On the $$クォーター$$ are $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$, Captain $$ガムリン$$, $$アクエリオン$$, $$アクエリオンＥＶＯＬ#robot$$...」

838:t_002:9.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Along with Ensign $$レド$$ and $$ラケージ$$!」

838:t_002:10.en:
$$メラン$$
「What shall we do, Captain $$ブライト$$...!?」

838:t_002:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We'll have to send the main force to rescue one, and the escort fleet to the other...!」

838:t_002:12.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Send the main force to rescue the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$.」
「Send the main force to rescue the $$マクロス・クォーター$$.」

838:t_003:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All ships, move to rescue the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$!」

838:t_003:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Have the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ support the $$クォーター$$!」

838:t_004:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is bad! The hyperspace we're in is collapsing!」
